name: Sugar, white, refined
note: Not in IFCT 2017 (book lists only jaggery I001 and cane juice I002). Refined sucrose is definitionally ~99.5g carb/100g; 398 kcal matches FSSAI label convention and USDA (387-400).

name: Curd, whole cow milk (dahi)
note: IFCT 2017 has no dahi row. Derived from IFCT L002 (milk, whole, cow: 73 kcal, 3.26/4.94/4.48) — fermentation converts lactose to lactic acid with negligible macro change. FLAG(nirmal): home dahi from toned milk would be ~58 kcal; whole-milk assumed.

name: Milk, toned (3.0% fat)
note: IFCT 2017 lists only whole cow (L002) and whole buffalo (L001). Toned milk is the FSSAI standard 3.0% fat / 8.5% SNF product; 58 kcal/100ml matches Amul/Mother Dairy toned labels.

name: Bread, white, sliced
note: IFCT 2017 covers ingredients, not prepared breads. Label-average of Britannia/Modern white sandwich bread (245-260 kcal/100g).

name: Instant noodles, with tastemaker (dry)
note: Branded packaged food, not in IFCT. Maggi 2-Minute Masala label: 313 kcal per 70g pack → 447/100g dry. dish_maggi uses 70g = one pack.

name: Cream, fresh (25% milk fat)
note: IFCT 2017 has no cream row. Amul Fresh Cream label (25% milk fat, ~250 kcal/100ml) — the pack home cooks actually use.

name: Tea leaves (infusion basis)
note: Leaves are strained out of chai; the infusion's energy contribution is negligible and the dish's kcal comes from milk and sugar. Zero by design, not by omission.
